messages:
sophia: Observability alert: tenant Z shows ~2x billed tokens vs runtime logs for a period. root cause looks like immediate client retries + cross-region requeueing. brief repro in ticket PLAT-2001.

omar: summary of the problem?

sophia: client POST -> edge returns 502 -> client retries within 2s -> both requests enter batcher -> runtime token counters double-count. retries sometimes modify trace headers so payload-hash dedupe misses.

lucas: options: 1) require client idempotency header (nope), 2) proxy-level short cache to collapse rapid retries, 3) add a canonical fingerprint carried through pipeline, 4) runtime-side canonical dedupe before billing.

mei: canonical fingerprint seems promising. need: canonicalizer spec, lib, and scheme versioning (fp_v). JSON bodies stable-serialize; form-encoded normalize; opaque bytes raw-hash.

omar: collision risk? we can use xxhash64; simulate on sample corpus to quantify. fallback rules: billing only dedup when fingerprint + model + token-size tolerance align.

lucas: proxy cache idea: short LRU keyed by (client-ip, short-body-prefix-hash) ttl 5s. collapses immediate retries. memory sharding and NAT collisions are concerns; implement sharded LRU with per-shard quotas.

mei: runtime dedupe: two-stage prefilter then canonicalize. pseudo: if len != then false; if cheap_hash(prefix) != then false; else canonical_hash compare.

sophia: telemetry: emit dedupe_attempts, dedupe_hits, dedup_token_savings_est. expose per-tenant rollups and ephemeral fingerprint-edge metrics with 24h retention to avoid high cardinality.

omar: rollout plan: A) RFC + canonicalization lib; B) edge: compute fp and create short-replay-index; C) batcher: honor X-Req-Fp header and fallback to canonical hash; D) runtime: prefilter + canonical dedupe before token accounting; E) billing: conservative dedupe consumer that requires fingerprint + model + token-match.

lucas: infra-bot, create ticket.

infra-bot: Created PLAT-2001 "canonical-fingerprint + edge-replay-cache for billing dedupe". canary repo and CI created.

sophia: action items: mei draft RFC + lib; omar run collision sims; lucas spike sharded LRU; i'll assemble sample traces and share. reconvene Wed 9am PT.

mei: ack :thumbsup:
